shown.sentence: Wound care encompasses the medical evaluation, cleaning, dressing, and treatment of skin injuries to promote proper healing and prevent infection.

label.evidence: The goal of wound care is to promote an environment that allows a wound to heal

judgeA.evidence: The goal of wound care is to promote an environment that allows a wound to heal
judgeA.note: A standard term, and cuts and bleeding are core home first aid. Placing it at layer 3 below Choking relief is somewhat arbitrary, since both are specific emergencies, but not wrong. Gemini's gloss and link (Australian Prescriber) use the clinical, chronic-wound sense.

judgeB.evidence: History of wound care (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wound_care redirects here)
judgeB.note: Ubiquitous term. Gemini's gloss is clinical (acute and chronic wounds); for home first aid it means cuts and scrapes. It sits at the same level as burns and choking, but L3 is harmless.

label.reason: Both judges agree on exists, fits, layerOk and problem; kept as labelled.
